reviews.title: Charged me even after I cancelled my subscription
reviews.text:
I was charged for a renewal several days after I canceled my subscription. I reported the charge to apple who denied my claim. I appealed the decision and they denied it again and told me to contact the developer, Fax. I contacted them via their customer support email. Then they told me they could not help me, and to contact their in-app support chat, even after I deleted the app. I reinstalled it only for the in-app chat support team to then tell me to report the charge to apple. 
They have no way of using you a refund if you’ve been incorrectly charged, even after cancellation, apparently, so I’ve been charged for another month by this company without a refund.
It was a lot of frustrating back and forth for two days, only to be told that the app developer cannot issue any refunds for anything downloaded via the App Store. Extremely frustrating. I will not be using this developer again. If anything, don’t use the App Store to download the product.

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: I had sent a fax and it said delivered. I called the recipient three times to confirm if they got it and they confirmed they did not each time. I reached out to customer service and they advised to check with the recipients troubleshooting, fax providers, and a laundry list of additional steps. Did exactly that, still no fax received. Long story short, they advised that since it shows delivered on their end that’s not their problem. Even if the recipients received the fax or not. I tried to address how that doesn’t seem normal to just advise a service was completed even though the recipients are saying they never received the fax. I did request a refund due to this and was told no refund can be issued even though their company policy advises otherwise. In other words, this sounds 100% like a scam. Don’t waste your time or money.

reviews.title: Do NOT use!
reviews.text: I am absolutely upset at this app. I was charged a weekly fee even AFTER I cancelled the subscription the first week. They offered me a 30 day FREE subscription when I attempted to cancel it within the first 7 days, but they would NOT accept the cancellation. Then, I asked for a refund and was told, no. I suggest NEVER downloading/using this service, but instead, use Google’s service which is either free or not domineering. I will NEVER use another Apple app such as this and am actually looking into switching back to Samsung due to this. All I wanted was my money back and that don’t happen, so I will continue to be vocal. Guess they needed to keep my money because it’s a rip off! My problem is them offering the 30-days and still taking my money! I am very disappointed and will also put a review on every other platform I can!

reviews.title: Unapproved charges
reviews.text: I downloaded this app for free to test it out.  My wife of 28 years recently passed and I need a fax service as I’m working on her estate.  This app seemed like a good choice.  I downloaded it, liked how it auto centered scans and allowed you to type a cover page.  Tested a fax out and was unknowingly put on a weekly subscription of $10.  I didn’t catch the charge immediately because it was going to my wife’s deactivated BOA account, then when I swapped our Apple payment to my card I was hit the charges.  Apple refused to refund the charges, so USAA is now investigating the charges on my behalf.  Had I known a test fax would have activated a subscription, I wouldn’t have tested it.  I might have considered a one month payment for use of the service, but after this headache I’ll find another service to use.
